subject: Add null check in updateSSLPendingFlag (#3641)
reason: The change adds a defensive null check in updateSSLPendingFlag (src/tls.c). It is unreachable as a behaviour change: the function's only three callers (connTLSRead, connTLSSyncRead, connTLSSyncReadLine) each invoke it immediately after SSL_read(conn->ssl, ...), so on any path where conn->ssl were NULL the process would already have crashed inside SSL_read before the check; conn->ssl is only NULLed in connTLSShutdown/connTLSClose, after which no read path runs. There is no observable difference between the parent and the fixed build in replies, replication, persistence or crash behaviour. Indep
